output.diagnosis: Payer notes describe a documentation blocker, not ordinary lateness: the place of supply on the invoice credits the tax to the wrong state, their AP will only process auto-populated credit, and they have asked when an amendment will be filed. A separate email reply cites an annual plant shutdown with skeleton payables staff and the signatory absent. No dispute over the goods or the commercial terms is stated, and payment history shows five prior invoices settled in full, though consistently past due.
output.reasoning: The stated obstacle is an invoice-document correction on our side; until someone internally confirms whether and when the amendment is filed, the payer's AP cannot process the credit, so another automated reminder or a payment link would not unblock anything and could read as ignoring a direct question. This is exactly the kind of billing-document correction that needs a human owner to answer. The shutdown/staffing note adds a plausible second reason contact is unlikely to help right now, but it contains no specific relative promise-to-pay, so I am not extracting one. Uncertainty: I cannot verify from this record whether the place-of-supply detail is actually wrong or already being amended; that determination belongs to a person. The receivable is substantial and unresolved, so ending automation outright would be premature.
